title: Sous Vide Chicken Tikka Masala
description: A twist on the classic Indian dish, using sous vide to cook the chicken to perfection. Serve with basmati rice and naan bread.
instructions: Season the chicken with salt, garam masala, cumin powder, coriander powder, and Kashmiri red chili powder.
In a blender, blend the yogurt, buttersweet, and 1 cup of water to make a marinade.
Add the marinade to the chicken and mix well.
Seal the chicken in a sous vide bag and cook at 63°C (145°F) for 2 hours.
Heat some oil in a pan and sauté the onions until they're lightly browned.
Add the tomatoes and cook for 10-12 minutes or until the sauce thickens.
Stir in the heavy cream and bring the sauce to a simmer.
Add the cooked chicken to the sauce and mix well.
Serve the chicken in the sauce with basmati rice and naan bread.
Garnish with fresh cilantro and serve hot.
